name: Northern Ireland disabled concessionary travel
description: nidirect information on free and reduced-fare SmartPass travel for eligible disabled people using bus and rail services in Northern Ireland.
intended_use: Check current Northern Ireland disability-related concessionary travel categories and the relevant SmartPass route.
audience_or_context: People resident in Northern Ireland who may meet current disability-related concessionary travel criteria.
limitations: Different disability categories can receive different concessions, including free or half-fare travel.
Eligibility depends on current Northern Ireland criteria and evidence.
This is a Northern Ireland-specific route.
cost_or_access_notes: nidirect lists the current SmartPass categories and concessions for eligible travellers.
conflicts_of_interest: nidirect is a first-party Northern Ireland public-service source; ND Oracle does not determine individual eligibility.
